title: Largest Contentful Paint percentiles (ms)
sqlTemplate: select approx_percentile_cont(view_largest_contentful_paint, 0.5) / 1000000.0 as p50, approx_percentile_cont(view_largest_contentful_paint, 0.75) / 1000000.0 as p75, approx_percentile_cont(view_largest_contentful_paint, 0.95) / 1000000.0 as p95, count(*) filter (where view_largest_contentful_paint is not null) as sample_count from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'view'
emptyDataSemantics: sample_count = 0 -> p50/p75/p95 are SQL NULL -> NO_DATA, never rendered as 0ms.
